items.label: Including the AIClient Library
items.content:
To use AIClient in browser environments, include the following script tag in your HTML. This makes the AIClient class available globally.

```html
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/HyperRushNet/hrn-ai/client/1.0.3.min.js"></script>
```

### What Happens When You Load This Script
- The AIClient library is initialized in the page.
- AIClient becomes globally accessible.
- No module bundlers or build steps are required.

### Requirements
- Include this script before any code that uses AIClient.
- This version is only for browser environments; it is not a Node.js package.

items.label: Basic Usage
API Key
items.content:
Set your API key using:

```javascript
client.setApiKey('YOUR_API_KEY');
```

This key is required to authenticate requests. Without it, `generate` will throw an error.

items.label: Model Selection
items.content:
Select the model you want to use:

```javascript
client.setModel('flux'); // default is 'flux'
```

Supported text & image models can be found on the [Pollinations Models Page](https://enter.pollinations.ai/#:~:text=Models).

items.label: Type (Text/Image)
items.content:
Define whether you want a text response or an image:

```javascript
client.setType('text'); // 'text' or 'image'
```

This determines the endpoint and the return type of `generate`.

items.label: System Prompt
items.content:
Set a system prompt for context (applies to text models):

```javascript
client.setSystemPrompt('You are a helpful assistant.');
```

This prompt is prepended to every text generation request.

items.label: Image Dimensions
items.content:
Set width and height for image generation:

```javascript
client.setDimensions(1024, 1024);
```

Defaults to 1024x1024 if not set.

items.label: Request Timeout
items.content:
Set the timeout (in milliseconds) for API requests:

```javascript
client.setTimeout(30000); // 30 seconds
```

The default is 30000ms (30s).

items.label: Retry Settings
items.content:
Configure automatic retry behavior for failed requests:

```javascript
client.setRetry(true, 2, 1000);
```
- First argument: enable retry (true/false)
- Second: number of retry attempts
- Third: delay between retries in milliseconds

items.label: Random Seed
items.content:
Optional seed for reproducible image generations:

```javascript
client.setSeed(12345);
```

If not set, a random seed is used each time.

items.label: Message History
items.content:
AIClient automatically keeps a history of text messages. You can clear it with:

```javascript
client.clearHistory();
```

Useful for starting fresh conversations.

items.label: generate(prompt)
items.content:
Generates a response from the AI model.

```javascript
const output = await client.generate('Your prompt here');
```

**Parameters:**
| Parameter | Type | Description |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| prompt    | string | The text prompt to send to the model |

**Returns:**
- `string` for text
- `Blob` for images

**Errors:**
- Throws if API key is missing
- Throws if prompt is empty
- Throws if request times out and retries are exhausted

Available Models
items.content:
AIClient supports multiple text and image models.

You can find a complete list of supported models here:
- [Pollinations Models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/#:~:text=Models)
- [Model Health](https://model-monitor.pollinations.ai/)

Each model may have different context length, supported modalities, and tools availability. Visit the links above for official documentation.
